description: Corrected test: are pathogenic GATAD2B missense variants enriched in the CR1/CR2 NuRD-interaction domains relative to benign missense variants?
code:
import requests, re, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
from scipy.stats import binomtest, fisher_exact

E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
ids=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",term="GATAD2B[gene]",retmax=1000,retmode="json"),timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    j=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",id=",".join(ids[i:i+200]),retmode="json"),timeout=120).json()["result"]
    for uid in j.get("uids",[]):
        d=j[uid]; recs.append(dict(title=d.get("title",""),clinsig=d.get("germline_classification",{}).get("description","")))
    time.sleep(0.4)
df=pd.DataFrame(recs)

AA=r"(?:Ala|Arg|Asn|Asp|Cys|Gln|Glu|Gly|His|Ile|Leu|Lys|Met|Phe|Pro|Ser|Thr|Trp|Tyr|Val)"
mis_re=re.compile(rf"p\.{AA}(\d+){AA}\)")
tr_re =re.compile(rf"p\.{AA}(\d+)(?:Ter|[A-Z][a-z]{{2}}fs)")

def grab(frame, rgx):
    out=[]
    for t in frame.title:
        m=rgx.search(t)
        if m: out.append(int(m.group(1)))
    return out

plp=df[df.clinsig.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])]
vus=df[df.clinsig=="Uncertain significance"]
ben=df[df.clinsig.isin(["Benign","Likely benign","Benign/Likely benign"])]

plp_mis=sorted(grab(plp,mis_re)); plp_tr=sorted(grab(plp,tr_re))
vus_mis=sorted(grab(vus,mis_re)); ben_mis=sorted(grab(ben,mis_re))
print("P/LP missense (n=%d): %s"%(len(plp_mis),plp_mis))
print("P/LP truncating (n=%d), range %d-%d"%(len(plp_tr),min(plp_tr),max(plp_tr)))
print("VUS missense n=%d | Benign+LB missense n=%d"%(len(vus_mis),len(ben_mis)))

CR1=(165,195); CR2=(340,480); ZNF=(414,467); L=593
dom_len=(CR1[1]-CR1[0]+1)+(CR2[1]-CR2[0]+1); exp=dom_len/L
inCR=lambda pos:[p for p in pos if CR1[0]<=p<=CR1[1] or CR2[0]<=p<=CR2[1]]
print("\nCR1+CR2 covers %d/%d aa = %.1f%% of p66-beta"%(dom_len,L,100*exp))
rows=[]
for nm,pos in [("P/LP missense",plp_mis),("VUS missense",vus_mis),("Benign/LB missense",ben_mis),("P/LP truncating",plp_tr)]:
    k=len(inCR(pos)); n=len(pos)
    bt=binomtest(k,n,exp,alternative="greater")
    print(f"  {nm:20s}: {k:3d}/{n:3d} = {100*k/n:5.1f}% in CR1+CR2 | binomial vs {100*exp:.1f}% expected, p={bt.pvalue:.3g}")
    rows.append((nm,k,n,100*k/n,bt.pvalue))

# P/LP missense vs VUS missense, and vs benign missense
a,b=len(inCR(plp_mis)),len(plp_mis)-len(inCR(plp_mis))
c,d_=len(inCR(ben_mis)),len(ben_mis)-len(inCR(ben_mis))
orr,pf=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d_]],alternative="greater")
print("\nFisher P/LP-missense vs Benign/LB-missense localisation to CR1+CR2: OR=%s, p=%.3g"%("inf" if np.isinf(orr) else round(orr,1),pf))
e_,f_=len(inCR(vus_mis)),len(vus_mis)-len(inCR(vus_mis))
orr2,pf2=fisher_exact([[a,b],[e_,f_]],alternative="greater")
print("Fisher P/LP-missense vs VUS-missense: OR=%s, p=%.3g"%("inf" if np.isinf(orr2) else round(orr2,1),pf2))

# ---------- Figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5,5.4))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,-0.20),L,0.40,facecolor="#E3E6EA",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((CR1[0],-0.20),CR1[1]-CR1[0],0.40,facecolor="#4C72B0",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((CR2[0],-0.20),CR2[1]-CR2[0],0.40,facecolor="#DD8452",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((ZNF[0],-0.12),ZNF[1]-ZNF[0],0.24,facecolor="#55A868",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.text(np.mean(CR1),-0.34,"CR1 165-195\nMBD2 / MBD3",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=8.5,color="#4C72B0")
ax.text(np.mean(CR2),-0.34,"CR2 340-480  histone-tail binding, CHD3/CHD4 recruitment",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=8.5,color="#DD8452")
ax.text(np.mean(ZNF),0.26,"GATA-type Zn finger 414-467",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#2F6B47")

for p in plp_tr:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.20,0.80],c="#AAAAAA",lw=0.6,zorder=1); ax.plot(p,0.80,"o",ms=3.5,c="#8C8C8C",zorder=2)
for p in ben_mis:
    ax.plot([p,p],[-0.20,-0.75],c="#CFCFCF",lw=0.5,zorder=1); ax.plot(p,-0.75,"o",ms=3,c="#B8C4A9",zorder=2)
for p in plp_mis:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.20,1.45],c="#C44E52",lw=1.6,zorder=3); ax.plot(p,1.45,"o",ms=9,c="#C44E52",zorder=4)
    ax.annotate(f"p.{p}",(p,1.52),ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#C44E52",fontweight="bold")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#C44E52",ms=8,label=f"P/LP missense (n={len(plp_mis)}), 100% in CR1/CR2")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#8C8C8C",ms=5,label=f"P/LP nonsense/frameshift (n={len(plp_tr)})")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#B8C4A9",ms=5,label=f"Benign/likely benign missense (n={len(ben_mis)})")
ax.set_xlim(-12,L+30); ax.set_ylim(-1.15,2.0); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("p66-beta amino acid position (UniProt Q8WXI9, 593 aa)")
ax.set_title("Every pathogenic GATAD2B missense variant in ClinVar lies in a NuRD-interaction domain;\nbenign missense variants avoid them")
ax.legend(loc="upper left",frameon=False,fontsize=9)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
